WakaTime data[]/cumulative_total/daily_average/timezone envelope flattened next to the AtoAxis days/calculation fields; data[] is built from the same clipped intervals as days[]. Reconciled against an independent WakaTime-algorithm reference (331 days, UTC and Asia/Bangkok). The range= shorthand and project/branches filters are not supported yet.
